decision: Route citation problems to useful author review without treating incomplete retrieval as contradiction.
primary_outcome: Confirmed actionable citation issues per reviewed paper, with reviewer minutes per confirmed issue.
denominator: All eligible papers and all attempted references, including retrieval failures; report reference coverage separately.
independence_unit: Paper; references within a paper share authors, topics and retrieval sources.
quality_guardrail: False refutation rate and unresolved-reference rate, with adjudicated labels separate from metadata matches.
minimum_data: Paper/reference IDs, retrieval completeness, source hash, verdict, adjudication status, reviewer time and resolved/unresolved outcome.
failure_handling: Failed retrieval and partial excerpts are unresolved, not clean citations or refutations. Keep them in coverage reporting.
release_rule: Require sufficiently bounded false refutation and useful issue yield before expanding automatic decisions; metadata agreement alone never establishes claim support.
reversal: Rising unresolved coverage or false refutations makes automatic rejection inappropriate; return to exception review.
status: PROPOSED MEASUREMENT CONTRACT; NOT AN EXECUTED DOMAIN EXPERIMENT
defense: Why is a missing quote not enough?
An excerpt may omit the relevant passage. Absence becomes meaningful only under adequate retrieval and an appropriate comparison.
Repeat use shows workflow engagement. It does not show that citation verdicts are correct, so I measure adjudicated quality separately.
